note: Stand-in paint. Scenario Art replaces the PNGs in place. back_far is drawn at full size and scaled up slightly. back_mid bleeds past the view. Front leaves are locked to the screen (parallax 1). Each leaf has an 8-bit greyscale sway mask at half size: 0 pinned, 255 full swing. leaf_shadow is greyscale, white = lit, multiply, green tint and a slow scroll in the shader. Import is linear with no mipmaps. back_far and back_mid are BC7/VRAM. Leaves, sway masks and the shadow are lossless.
parallax_meaning: 0 sticks to the world, 1 sticks to the screen. Back plates sit on the camera and slide by -pan * (1 - factor). Front leaves are screen-locked.
